brief:
Hundreds of pro-Palestine demonstrators marched on Labour's annual conference in Liverpool, Middle East Eye reported, calling for an end to British military exports to Israel. The protest marked the first party conference since Andy Burnham assumed the role of prime minister.

The demonstration took place as Labour held its annual gathering, with activists present outside the venue to voice their opposition to the policy.

title: Pro-Palestine protesters demand UK halt arms sales to Israel
